chunks: We have explained in various ways all things to men in this Qur'an; but of all things man is most contentious.
ai.seo_question: Why is man described as the most contentious in the Qur'an?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the Qur'an's pedagogical versatility, employing diverse 'masal' (parables) to address varying human temperaments, yet it highlights a specific spiritual obstacle: human stubbornness (jadal). Scholars note that while the divine message is clear and comprehensive, the human tendency to debate rather than reflect often leads to self-imposed misguidance, a theme particularly emphasized in the context of Surah Al-Kahf's narratives of faith and denial.
